answer: Sybil resistance arises because each bonded identity exposes collateral, while correlated equivocation links their actions: for k coordinated identities, penalties grow quadratically, O(k^2), rather than linearly. Detection then applies an exponential capital-loss multiplier across the swarm, making mass control economically prohibitive; a gale of false votes cannot hide behind a lantern, while honest history remains a relic of separable behavior.
